Name: Simple Fridge Upgrade
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]Simple Fridge Upgrade[/b]
Give your kitchen more storage with two upgrades for the farmhouse fridge and Mini-Fridges. Expand each fridge from 36 to 70, then 120 slots, while keeping its contents available for normal cooking.

[center][size=4][b]Version 1.1 — Mini-Fridge pickup protection[/b][/size]
Purchased 70- and 120-slot Mini-Fridge upgrades are now protected when an alternate tool-pickup path creates an item by ID. The existing host pickup protection stays in place.
Empty a Mini-Fridge before moving it. Its upgrade tier stays with the protected pickup and is restored when placed again. Farmhouse-fridge upgrades, cooking access, recipes and costs are unchanged.
Close the game before updating and keep your existing config.json.[/center]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Upgrade each fridge separately to 70 or 120 slots.[/*]
[*]Silver [b]F[/b] icon for Kit I and iridium-purple [b]F[/b] icon for Kit II.[/*]
[*]Ingredients stay in the original fridge and remain available for cooking.[/*]
[*]Upgraded Mini-Fridges keep their upgrade when picked up and placed again.[/*]
[*]Wider storage menus when space allows, with pages for smaller windows.[/*]
[*]Supports all 12 built-in game languages.[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support for upgrade confirmation.[/*]
[/list][b]How to obtain[/b]
After the host’s first farmhouse upgrade, the Kit I crafting recipe unlocks automatically. Kit II unlocks after the second farmhouse upgrade. Existing saves receive eligible recipes when loaded or at the start of the next day.
[b]Fridge Upgrade Kit I — 70 slots[/b]
Buy from Robin for [b]10,000g[/b], or craft with:
[list]
[*]10 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]10 Refined Quartz[/*]
[*]1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list][b]Fridge Upgrade Kit II — 120 slots[/b]
Buy from Robin for [b]30,000g[/b], or craft with:
[list]
[*]10 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]3 Iridium Bars[/*]
[*]20 Refined Quartz[/*]
[*]2 Battery Packs[/*]
[/list]Recipes are free to unlock. Robin sells finished kits.

[b]How to use[/b]
Select a kit in your hotbar and interact with a closed farmhouse fridge or placed Mini-Fridge, then confirm the upgrade. Each fridge must receive Kit I before Kit II.
Cancelled or invalid upgrades do not consume a kit.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Uses the game’s native fridge inventories and cooking system. Designed to work with native fridges and modded ingredients, including those used alongside Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village. Mods that replace fridge storage or menus may need additional compatibility support.
For multiplayer, every player should install the same version. Live multiplayer and full SVE/Ridgeside playthroughs have not been fully tested.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/b].
Extract the [b]SimpleFridgeUpgrade[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch through SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

[b]Before uninstalling[/b]
Empty upgraded fridges and dispose of unused upgrade kits, then save before removing the mod. Uninstalling restores normal fridge capacity.
